integrity: The sharp formula and dimension-dependent contact regularity follow analytically; the 205 quadrature tests and eight high-precision cusp tests verify selected cases and do not certify all dimensions. The projector has no claimed independent validation.
scientific_limitations: The result addresses concentric Euclidean shells and the affine degree-one L2 projector with normalized volume. No monotonicity in hole radius, nonconcentric-domain statement or higher-degree projection theorem is established. Priority against unindexed literature is not certified.
title: Sharp affine-projection norms on spherical shells and a universal hole-contact singularity
